_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: In a coil with 4% directional hit rate and no visible breaker—no inflow spark, no flush catalyst, funding already neutral—the skilled call is to hold position and wait for the coil to resolve rather than force a directional guess.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (upward drift into distrustful recovery) while narrative implies a coiling accumulation bottom ready to surprise upward; the analyst's own 18.2% direction accuracy and the 4% coil hit rate make HOLD the only honest consensus.
next_move.invalidated_if: vix >80 with btc_momentum_30d <35 and funding <0.005% — panic flush to Anxiety/Panic band
